name: Rabih Elkhodr
title: Presentation trainer, keynote speaker and published author
bio_short: Presentation trainer and published author with 13 years' experience across eight countries and three languages. Clients include DEWA, Bayer, Booz Allen Hamilton and Mohammed Bin Rashid Space Centre. More than 25 TEDx speakers coached. Trilingual.
bio: Rabih is a presentation trainer, keynote speaker and published author with 13 years' experience. He has trained more than 5,000 people in eight countries and three languages. Rabih has coached more than 25 TEDx speakers whose talks have collectively accumulated more than 11 million views, and he has been credited on TED.com as a speaker coach. He is the author of Public Speaking X: Tips to Unleash the TED Speaker in You.  His corporate training clients include DEWA, Bayer, Booz Allen Hamilton, Mohammed Bin Rashid Space Centre, ADIB, Emirates Foundation, NAFFCO, the UAE Ministry of Health and the UAE National Archives. His career spans marketing communications, human resources and organisational learning, giving him a rounded understanding of how communication skills contribute to professional effectiveness across functions.  At ISOC, Rabih delivers public speaking and presentation skills programmes. He is particularly effective at helping participants move from adequate presenters to genuinely engaging speakers who can hold an audience's attention and deliver their message with impact. His trilingual capability in English, Arabic and French makes him well suited to training programmes across the MENA region and in multilingual European environments. Rabih is based in Canada with frequent work across the Middle East.
